structured_output.summary: The change follows the spec for padEnd and StringPaddingBuiltinsImpl. RequireObjectCoercible runs first, then ToString(this), ToLength(maxLength), the length early-return, and the fillString undefined/ToString branch. After that, StringPad returns the string if the filler is empty, otherwise builds the filler and appends it. Every `?` is propagated. The observable operations happen in spec order and once each. The string stays rooted across the conversions that can allocate. The only addition is a RangeError for results longer than 2^29-24 units. That is an implementation-defined length limit, it comes after the empty-filler return, and it is documented in the code. All 26 target tests pass with no regressions.
